name: Inmu Gakuen "Dame... Konna ni Nacchau no wa Yume no Naka dake nano...!"
original_name: 淫夢学園「だめ…こんなになっちゃうのは夢の中だけなの…！」
source:
Shinji is a high school student. He loves Mayuri, his classmate. One day, a sick-room teacher, Ryoko, gives him a pendant. It seems people can have a good dream if they sleep with it. On that night, he goes to bed, holding the pendant.... A while later, when he wakes up, he finds himself being in Mayuri's room. Mayuri is asleep in the bed.... He gets sexually excited and has sex with her...! However, nothing has changed following the next day.... He is relieved and randomly has sex with other girls.... What's the secret of the pendant? What will happen to him in the end...?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090103030435/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1009109]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
高中生真治一直暗恋着同班女生真由理。某天，学校保健医凉子送给他一枚吊坠，据说只要戴着它入睡便能做个美梦。当晚，真治攥着吊坠沉沉睡去……不知过了多久，等他再度睁开眼时，竟发现自己置身于真由理的闺房之中，而真由理正躺在床上熟睡……情欲高涨的他当即占有了她的身体……！谁知到了第二天，现实中却仿佛无事发生一般……松了一口气的真治自此肆无忌惮起来，开始在梦中随心所欲地侵犯其他女生……这枚吊坠背后究竟隐藏着怎样的秘密？等待他的又将是怎样的结局……？
